asyncPattern.shape: The fetch is a Foldkit Command (ReadDiagnostics) whose execute is an Effect.tryPromise over the injected reader. init/update return the Command; the runtime runs the batch after update returns and dispatches the resulting Message (DiagnosticsLoaded or DiagnosticsFailed), which is the only way the view changes. The view never runs an effect.

The runtime runs the Command batch after update returns and dispatch happens outside the reducer: src/update/update.ts:124-127.

diagnosticsTests: ok: data-state ok, records render code/level/count, identity instance/build shown
empty: data-state empty, 'No diagnostics records' text, distinct from denied
disabled: data-state disabled, wording 'state, not an error', no error state node, build: missing with a null identity
stale: data-state stale with the rule (5m) and age (15m)
dropped: data-state dropped with loss count (12) and window (10m)
independent conditions: stale+dropped and dropped+stale show both, neither masks the other
denied: 401 renders 'Access denied' at data-state denied
denied rather than an empty list: no empty state node and no empty-list text for a 401
transport error: rejected reader renders data-state error with the rejection message, no denied state
identity honesty: null identity and buildId 'unknown' both label 'build: missing'
async: loading state while the reader promise is pending, reader called once, signal is an AbortSignal, result Message then renders empty
refresh: clicking [data-action=refresh-diagnostics] runs the Command again (2 calls) and the second result Message renders
a11y/responsive contract: panel w-full + sm:p-6, layout md:grid-cols-2, refresh is a native button with focus-visible:ring-2 and w-full, nav anchors have hrefs and focus-visible:ring-2
green.regressions: S14a mount/dispose (1/1) and S14b routing (4/4) still pass in the same 18-test run.

typecheck.note: No errors on the first full run; test files are included in tsconfig and the injected reader type is shared with the test. Biome on the 11 changed files: exit 0 (s15b-biome-check.log).

domSimulationLimits: happy-dom has no CSS layout engine: the narrow layout is proven as a class contract (w-full, max-w-3xl, p-4/sm:p-6, md:grid-cols-2, flex-wrap), not measured at 390px. Visual focus rings are likewise asserted as classes plus native button/anchor semantics; happy-dom does not implement sequential Tab traversal, so actual keyboard order and focus visibility are not measured.
aria-live/role=status announcements are attributes only; no screen reader consumes them in this harness.

The reader is injected, so the real HTTP path, credential/loopback authorization, CORS/header behavior and the 401 gate are not exercised. The read module says the production source is deferred and currently answers disabled outside tests (:20-24).

AbortSignal presence is asserted (Effect.tryPromise forwards it), but disposal/cancellation behavior (a late response being ignored) is not tested; the update does ignore messages whose id no longer matches the current route, and that guard is not directly tested.
Staleness/ages come from injected numbers, not the wall clock.
unverifiedOrBlocked: Host-bridge HTTP wiring for the page reader is out of scope (files may only be written under apps/runtime-ui-next/src and tests). Binding a fetch reader to LOCAL_DIAGNOSTICS_PATH + the operator auth gate is a follow-up; the read module currently has no composition root (its own DEFERRED WIRE note).
Pagination: truncated/cursor are displayed as text only; there is no 'load more' control and no next-page Command.
Denied is modelled from a reader status 401/403 (as the read module says denied is the handler's 401 and never reaches it); the actual handler gate is untested here.
Build identity honesty is heuristic: null, empty and 'unknown' buildId are labelled missing; other unknown sentinels are not known to this page.
